svg.title: One workspace keeps files across sessions
svg.desc: Your code uploads people.csv into the workspace's uploads folder. A run in session A gets the workspace files at run start, writes script.py and output.json, and they are saved to the workspace when the run ends. A later run in session B, with its own conversation, passes the same workspaceId and gets people.csv, script.py and output.json restored at run start. Your code lists the files with download URLs that expire after 60 seconds. Files sync between runs, not live: finish one writer before starting a run that needs its changes. Limits: 950 MiB per workspace, 50 MiB per upload.
